I was in crisis trying to locate a 65 gallon tank for my red eared slider who started peeling up the silicone on her tank. Father Nature Aquarium Services connected me with Gil at The Pet Store. He came with the tank within 4 hours. Saved my apartment from a flood! Before I had gotten connected with them, another service sent me to PetCo where I not only couldn't find a replacement but got nothing out of the customer service. It's local for the win every time. Can't recommend this store enough. Thanks Gil!

i will start by saying i only visit the aquatics section and occasionally get litter for my cats. i have several tanks and a hobby of mine is aquascaping so ive dropped by several times to get plants from here. more often than not, they were in amazing condition and very affordable compared to getting them online. id also rather support a local business than a petco.

there are a lot of great things about this store. the staff is always helpful and very accommodating. theyve even ordered something for me that i needed for my cats. it's kept very tidy, as tidy as a pet store can get, haha, and the selection is fairly good (again, i mostly keep to the cat section and aquatics.)

however, i would be hesitant to purchase a fish from there. regardless of where you go to shop for this hobby, seeing a dead fish or a fish with swim bladder issues will be inevitable, but my concern is with how the tanks are stocked. some tanks have species that are incompatible and others are overstocked, even for a temporary sales tank. it's a local business, but im not a businessman so i wont pretend to know how the logistics work here---its just that when i go, some of the fish look stressed and stressed fish are prone to disease.

i am not discouraging anyone from getting a fish from here. i am mainly wanting to give feedback to management as i do love visiting this place and eventually hope i can come here to get my fish too.
